decision: Add default finite task-wide ceiling of six failed captures across step names and signatures, independent of three repeated identical failures.
requirements: Successful checks do not erase failed history; changing signatures or findings do not reset finite task budget.
Explicit task recovery must contain finite numeric ceiling, not truthy narrative/amendment authority.

Distinct successful QA entries do not consume failure budget. A semantic-negative raw nonzero capture may prove a successful pinned expected refusal; avoid treating validated negative success as ordinary repair failure.
scope: Existing brief task-wide execution budget only; no new subsystem or nested contract process.
